about: Nested ecoregions used by plant nativeRange and scene ecoregions in assets/index.jsonl. North America uses the CEC/EPA ecoregion hierarchy (Level I > II > III); WWF terrestrial ecoregions are the global fallback where no EPA level applies. Only the regions the index uses are listed; add more as plants and scenes need them. Nativeness is computed at runtime from the yard's location against these ids and is never stored. It never restricts placement: it is a likelihood weight for visiting birds and a classification.

sources.epa: US EPA / CEC, Ecological Regions of North America (Level I, II) and Level III Ecoregions of the Continental United States (2013 revision). https://www.epa.gov/eco-research/ecoregions
sources.wwf: Olson et al. 2001, Terrestrial Ecoregions of the World (WWF). https://www.worldwildlife.org/publications/terrestrial-ecoregions-of-the-world
